text.description_html:
Laurey 72828, 7/8 Inch Square Satin Nickel Cosmopolitan Knob

The 7/8 Inch Square Satin Nickel Cosmopolitan Knob has a transitional style that is great for most kitchens. The Satin Nickel is trending in kitchen decor so all you hardware can match: faucets, cabinet hardware, and refrigerator handles. This Square Satin Nickel Cosmopolitan Knob features a square inlay that will add interest to any lightweight door or drawer. The 7/8 Square Cabinet Knob Satin Nickel comes packaged with the mounting hardware.

This cabinet knob is part of the Laurey Cosmopolitan Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 72828 Satin Nickel Square Cosmopolitan Cabinet Knob:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish:Satin Nickel
  • Length: 7/8" square
  • Projection: 3/4"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screw and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screw.

Available in 4 finishes:
Satin Nickel Oil Rubbed Bronze Champagne Brass Polished Chrome

Sold Individually
